spellbook.finance/limitations: window.from and window.to are inclusive date cutoffs, not a promise of one observation per day. Missing dates stay absent; this read neither fills gaps nor interpolates values.
Each date is a stored EV observation date, not an underlying card-price capture time. provenance.fetchedAt dates this read. The last history point can be older than the current product snapshot.

Historical rows omit model revisions, source-price observation clocks and the evRatio valuation basis. Changes can reflect prices, card coverage or model updates; the series establishes no constant-methodology or price-only return.

Amounts are stored USD valuations per sealed product, before selling fees and fulfillment. They are not realized proceeds, net profit, executable offers or a forecast. packsPerBox belongs to the returned product identity; do not assume a pack count.

An empty observations array means no stored rows in this product/window. It does not establish zero EV, a complete historical series or a successful recent computation. The read returns no current EV; use a separately dated product snapshot when needed.

annotations.title: Read a sealed product's EV history

description: Read stored daily gross opening-EV observations for one exact sealed product. Use it when asked how a named box's EV changed over time. Resolve the product with spellbook_sealed_product_search first; pass its numeric tcgProductId. Returns product identity, requested dates, USD values per sealed product, dated source rows and explicit model/freshness gaps. Missing dates stay absent. Read guideResourceUri through MCP for date, valuation and model interpretation. An older history point is not today's EV. The response establishes no price-only cause or unchanged methodology.

days.description: Lookback in days, from 1 to 365. Defaults to 183 days; calendar-month lengths vary. The returned window gives the actual inclusive UTC dates.

tcgProductId.description: Exact numeric TCGplayer sealed-product id from spellbook_sealed_product_search. Required; do not pass a card id or product name.
